notes: Your Sidekick: Your sidekick answers: the one you chose in Settings → Sidekick answers every question in its own voice. No more being passed between cats. It understands everyday wording and typos. “What coin is performing best?” (even “waht coin is perfoming best”) shows the real results per coin: your own bets, the Litter Box’s one-coin models and Backtrack, each labelled with when it was read. It remembers the conversation while the app is open, so follow-ups like “why?”, “what about SOL?” or “compare it to ETH” just work.
